description: This file defines a Fragment class for an Android application that demonstrates synchronized notifications between a handset and a wearable device (such as an Android Wear watch). It includes methods to build local-only notifications, wearable-only notifications, and mirrored notifications that synchronize dismissal across devices. It interacts with GoogleApiClient and Wearable DataApi to coordinate data and notification handling across devices.

classes.name: SynchronizedNotificationsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages synchronized notifications between a mobile device and a wearable device, implementing connection callbacks and notification building methods.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and sets up connection callbacks.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to trigger different notification actions.

methods.name: buildLocalOnlyNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a local-only notification, optionally with a dismissal PendingIntent to synchronize dismissal.

methods.name: buildWearableOnlyNotification
methods.description: Creates a DataItem that prompts the wearable device to display a notification.

methods.name: buildMirroredNotifications
methods.description: Creates a pair of notifications on both phone and wearable that are linked/dismissed together.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when the GoogleApiClient successfully connects.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback for suspension of GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient fails to connect.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Utility method that returns the current time as a formatted string.
